getDataset.title: NFHS-5 district fact sheet indicators on maternal and child health for Uttar Pradesh
getDataset.description: This dataset contains district fact sheet indicators from the National Family Health Survey round 5. It covers maternal health, child nutrition and immunisation. Indicators are reported for every district of Uttar Pradesh. The survey was conducted in 2019–21 by the Example Health Ministry. Values are percentages of the relevant population. The data can be used to prioritise district health interventions. Survey rounds are released roughly every five years.
